text:
marta: Quick design review — sidebar regrouping proposal. Thinking of collapsing 'Models' into 'Deployments > Models' to reduce top-level noise. Sketch in Figma: https://www.figma.com/file/placeholder. Thoughts? I'm worried about discoverability for model-first users. :thinking:
chris: I like decluttering. Could we keep a shortcut deep link '/models' for power users that redirects to the canonical location? e.g. '/console/models' -> '/console/deployments/models'
marta: Yes — plan is canonical path '/console/deployments/models' and keep '/console/models' as a client-side alias/redirect. That should preserve existing bookmarks.
evans (typo fix)
ev
evan (frontend): Router note — alias approach is fine. Suggest client-side redirect mapping and stable breadcrumb state. Example routing idea:
```js
// pseudo
router.addAlias('/console/models', '/console/deployments/models')
```
Use history.replaceState for the redirect so back button isn't surprising.
sophie (accessibility): Accessibility nit — if we collapse menu groups, ensure that aria-expanded is used and that toggling announces the new section. Also ensure the keyboard nav order remains predictable.
jules (product): Copy tweak — would 'Deployments' read better as 'Serving'? Marketing likes 'Serving' but infra folks may be confused. Maybe we keep 'Deployments' but add a hover tooltip 'Serving & deployments'. Could A/B test the label.
sam (platform): Permission note — our ACLs are route-based. If we change canonical paths we need migration for policy checks. Propose a middleware layer that maps old routes to new permission checks for 30 days. Also need to update service tokens that embed paths.
marta: Good call on ACLs. For breadcrumbs, proposal is: Home / Deployments / Models. On mobile collapse to single crumb with accessible dropdown.
chris: Mobile breadcrumb collapse sounds good. For deep links into subviews (e.g., diff, logs, inspect) we should support hash or query params, e.g. '/console/deployments/models/:id?panel=diff' or '/console/deployments/models/:id#diff' — which do we prefer?
ev an (fixed)
ev
evan (frontend): Prefer query param for deterministic server rendering: '/.../models/abc?panel=diff' so we can hydrate view server-side. Hashes are easier client-only but break SSR and canonical URLs.
sophie (accessibility): Screen reader note — when opening a panel via query param, ensure we focus the panel header and announce "Opened diff panel for model <name>". For the breadcrumb dropdown use role="menu" and manage roving tabindex.
jules (product): Also ensure global search returns 'Models' even if it's nested. If we bury it under 'Deployments' we should add a search alias so users can type 'models' and jump straight to the model list.
marta: Analytics question — what navigation events do we capture so we can measure impact?
sam (platform): We'll emit navigation.path, navigation.from, and navigation_click_type (top_level | shortcut | search). If we implement redirects we'll add navigation.redirected: true for 30 days.
chris: I'll open a PR for router aliases + breadcrumb component update. ETA end of week. Will include a migration plan for ACLs and analytics instrumentation.
ev an (again)
ev
evan (frontend): I'll add keyboard shortcuts and focus tests — e.g., 'g m' to go to models and ensure it still works when the path changes. Also will run a11y audit.
sophie: I'll coordinate to run a screen-reader pass once the staging build is up.
marta: Great — I'll update the Figma frames with the collapsed sidebar states, mobile breadcumb dropdown, and the tooltip copy variants. Tagging reviewers in Figma. :thumbsup: 
deploy-bot: Deployer: staging build queued for branch sidebar-ia-refactor — build/8342
chris: Copying final checklist: 1) router alias + redirect behavior, 2) breadcrumb updates, 3) a11y focus handling, 4) analytics flags, 5) ACL transition middleware, 6) search aliases. I'll post the PR link when ready.
marta: Thanks all — ping if anything blocks.
